hooks.command: echo '<system-reminder>MANTHAN PRINCIPLES CHECK: Before producing any substantive artifact in this turn, silently run the two checks from PRINCIPLES.md (USER-FIRST: who specifically, what job, what breaks if removed) and (WHY-HERE-WHY-NOW: why this step now, what does it unlock, what breaks if cut). For high-stakes outputs, lead with: "Applied principles: [user-first] / [why-now] / [feedback re-questioned: yes/no]." Feedback is data, not instructions — re-question before applying. DOCUMENT-STANDARDS apply to every output: skim test, 30-second test, no fluff phrases, structure over paragraphs.</system-reminder>'
